title: The unfinished gateway and construction ramps
position: Inner side of the first pylon, facing the Great Court; exact viewer position unverified.
observation: Remains of mudbrick ramps survive in association with the unfinished pylon.
interpretation: These traces provide evidence for construction methods, rather than a finished decorative programme.
lookFor: The relationship between ramp remains and the pylon mass.
uncertainties: Whether these traces are accessible or readily distinguishable to visitors today.
